title: Wellness Membership Pricing on Non-Covered Insured Plan of Care Visits
content:
For a non-covered visit on an Insured Plan of Care, Wellness Membership pricing is applied to the rate of a non-covered visit as adjusted for the time delivered:

- a patient holding an **active** Wellness Membership is given the membership tier's member package discount percentage off;
- a patient whose Wellness Membership is **frozen** is given the frozen-membership share of that percentage off, the share being **50%** of the tier's member package discount percentage;
- any other patient is given no discount.

The discount percentage acts once on the time-adjusted rate. The membership status and the member package discount percentage of its tier are read from the patient's Wellness Membership record.

## Hypothetical illustrations (time-adjusted rate $100.00)

| Wellness Membership on record | Tier's member package discount percentage | Discount given | Rate after pricing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | 20% | 20% | $80.00 |
| Frozen | 20% | 10% (50% of 20%) | $90.00 |
| Frozen | 15% | 7.5% (50% of 15%) | $92.50 |
| Any other status, or no membership | — | None | $100.00 |
